# Generic backup exclusions, consumed by backup.sh (rsync --exclude-from).
#
# This list is concatenated after ~/.no_backup.txt and is applied to every
# transfer root of backup.sh: $HOME and /etc share the same rules, and
# --delete-excluded removes newly excluded files from the destination.
#
# Anchoring convention (rsync semantics):
#   - No slash (name, *.ext)    : matches that name at ANY depth, in $HOME and
#                                 in /etc. Reserve it for names that are
#                                 unambiguous junk (.DS_Store, *.swp,
#                                 __pycache__/, node_modules/).
#   - Leading "/"               : anchored to the transfer root ($HOME or /etc).
#   - Slash inside the pattern  : also anchored to the transfer root, so
#                                 ".config/**/X" only looks under ~/.config.
#   - Leading "**/"             : any depth, used for tool conventions that
#                                 live in many places (steamapps/common/,
#                                 compatdata/, Crashpad/).
#   - Trailing "/"              : directories only.
# Over-broad names that also exist in source trees or user documents (dist/,
# build/, out/, coverage/, target/, venv/, tmp/, cache) are deliberately NOT
# excluded unanchored. Only unambiguous sub-paths (target/debug/) or
# top-level directories (/tmp/) are listed.
#
# Never list user content here (documents, media, databases, VM images,
# conversation or history data, SSH/GPG keys, user settings).

# ---- OS and file manager junk ----
._*
